note: Level 1 strumming-first additions (26 Oct 2026): strummed chords for most of the recording, three or fewer shapes from A, D, E once a capo of 0-4 is applied. Capo, setup and skill notes are authored suggestions from chord sheets; not checked against the recordings beyond the automatic chart sanity check.

songs.title: Give Peace a Chance
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 4 suggested: the record is about a semitone below D/A, so it sounds in C# with G#; with the capo on the 4th fret the open A and E shapes match.
songs.skill_focus: Two shapes, A and E, alternating in a loose, steady strum under a singalong. The easiest first change in the set; keep the strum even and relaxed.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Give Peace A Chance (2010 remaster)

songs.title: Achy Breaky Heart
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, E and D shapes.
songs.skill_focus: A steady country two-step strum on A and E with a D in the chorus. Mostly strummed acoustic and electric rhythm; count four even beats per bar.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Achy Breaky Heart

songs.title: Bye Bye Love
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D and E shapes.
songs.skill_focus: Driving acoustic strum on three open chords with a quick, stop-start feel. Start with a steady down-strum on each beat and learn the changes first.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Bye Bye Love

songs.title: La Bamba
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 3 suggested: the record is in C with C, F and G, and with the capo on the 3rd fret the open A, D and E shapes sound the same chords.
songs.skill_focus: The same three chords all the way through with a bright, fast strum. Start slow with one strum per beat and speed up gradually.

songs.title: Down on the Corner
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 3 suggested: the record is in C with C, G and F, and with the capo on the 3rd fret the open A, E and D shapes sound the same chords.
songs.skill_focus: Chunky rhythm guitar on three chords at a relaxed mid-tempo. Strum down-down-up-up-down-up and keep the changes on the bar line.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Down On The Corner

songs.title: Not Fade Away
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open E, A and D shapes.
songs.skill_focus: The Bo Diddley rhythm: a pulsing strum on mostly E and A, with a D at the turnaround. Feel the accent pattern and keep the strum steady.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Not Fade Away (single version)

songs.title: Stir It Up
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D and E shapes.
songs.skill_focus: Relaxed reggae pulse with short chops on the off-beats. Start with steady downstrokes, then mute and chop on the 'and' of each beat.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Stir It Up

songs.title: That's All Right
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D and E shapes (7th versions optional).
songs.skill_focus: A swung, driving rockabilly strum on a 12-bar-style A, D and E sequence; the recording is acoustic rhythm guitar with slap bass.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: That's All Right

songs.title: Jackson
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). Capo 3 suggested: the record is in C with C, F and G7, and with the capo on the 3rd fret the open A, D and E shapes sound the same chords.
songs.skill_focus: A boom-chick country strum on three chords. Alternate a low bass note with a strum on beats 2 and 4; ignore the picked intro riff at first.

songs.title: Lay Down Sally
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D and E shapes; the G and F#m passing chords are optional.
songs.skill_focus: A relaxed country shuffle on A, D and E. Lay back on the beat and let the strum swing; leave out the passing chords at first.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Lay Down Sally

songs.title: Peggy Sue
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D and E shapes; the single F in the bridge can be Fmaj7.
songs.skill_focus: Fast, tremolo-style strumming with tom drums; the quickest tempo in this set, so start well below the recording.

songs.title: Rock Around the Clock
songs.setup_note: Standard tuning (EADGBE). No capo suggested: open A, D and E shapes (7th versions optional).
songs.skill_focus: A fast 12-bar swing on A, D and E. Use it as a stretch goal: practise slowly with the speed control and keep the strum light.

sources.title: SongBPM tempo listing: Rock Around the Clock
